issue.title: Bug: The deprecated vrf definition command is no longer accepted in cEOS 4.35

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The test_bgp_stress_link_flap.py failed due to unreachable T2 neighbors. The reason is the old VRF configuration syntax, vrf definition, is no longer accepted by cEOS 4.35, which caused the missing VRF configuration on the management interface and the subsequent shutdown/no_shutdown actions
failed due to unreachable host error.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_bgp_stress_link_flap.py on t1-64-lag topo.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should pass. All neighbor VMs should be reachable.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Not all BGP sessions are established on DUT
```

resolution.title: Fix the deprecated vrf configuration command for cEOS 4.35
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

In cEOS build 4.35, the old syntax of 'vrf definition' is no longer accepted, which caused the missing configuration on the management interface of neighbor VMs. The Ansible shutdown/no_shutdown commands failed to execute on the neighbor VM due to unreachable mgmt interface.

Summary:
Fixes #26025

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
To fix the deprecated VRF configuration command on impacted topos.

#### How did you do it?
